## About
E&N Towing and Auto Service is a full service maintenance and repair shop on East Main Street in Bridgewater. We handle the everyday work like tune-ups, oil changes, brakes and exhaust, and we specialize in engine and transmission rebuilding and installation.
Our technicians are ASE Certified, and we use OEM parts so your warranty stays intact. We also run towing and roadside assistance across Somerset County, so if your car quits on you, we can bring it straight to the shop.
If you're waiting on your car, there's a comfortable waiting room with WiFi, snacks and a TV.

## Services
- Towing and roadside assistance: Towing and roadside help for drivers across Somerset County.
- Engine and transmission rebuilding: Our specialty: rebuilding and installing engines and transmissions.
- Tune-ups, oil change and brakes: Bring your car in for tune-ups, an oil change or brakes.

## FAQ
Q: Do you tow around the clock?
A: Yes. We offer towing 24/7.

Q: Will using your shop affect my warranty?
A: We use OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) parts, so your warranty will remain intact.

Q: Is there somewhere to wait while my car is worked on?
A: Yes. We have a comfortable waiting room with WiFi, snacks and a TV.
